label: Diagram 11.3
caption: Diagram 11.3 Notional boundary | Unprotected areas and fire resistance
description: This is a plan view. A large dashed rectangle forms the outer perimeter, with a leader line from its top edge reading 'Site boundary'. Inside sit two rectangles with thick black outlines: the left one labelled 'Building A', the right one 'Building B'. A vertical green dashed line stands between them and is labelled 'Notional boundary' by a short leader line. Below, two horizontal green lines with double-headed arrowheads meet at a green cross mark on that line. The left line spans the gap from Building A's right face to the notional boundary and is labelled 'Compliance with the provisions for space separation in respect of building A'; the right line spans the gap from the notional boundary to Building B's left face and carries the matching label for building B. The top-left corner reads 'See para 11.5'. Below the diagram, a section headed 'NOTES:' gives an introductory sentence and two numbered rules for setting the notional boundary, and a green footer bar reads 'Diagram 11.3 Notional boundary'.
